text: Cephalic index, Kinh 18-25: very short (>86) men 40.3% women 44.7%; short 33.9/36.8%; medium 21.6/14.9%; long+very long 4.2/3.6%.
Total facial index: very wide (<80) men 44.9% women 26.5%; wide 36.1/30.0%; medium 13.1/32.7%; long 3.9/8.1%; very long 2.1/2.7%.
Nasal index: narrow (55-70) men 9% women 26%; medium 43/46%; wide (85-100) 35.6/21%; very wide 9.5/4.6%; hyper wide 2.9/1.3%; very narrow 0.03/0.95%.
Prognathism index: none men 91.1% women 87.2%; prognathic 6.2/6.4%; very prognathic 2.7/6.4%.
Mandibular index (gonial / face width): wide men 92.9% women 98.4%; narrow 4.4/0.5%. Narrow jaws are rare in Kinh women.
Mean sizes men/women (mm): face width 138.6/131.2, nose width 40.8/37.5, mouth width 50.4/48.3, eye width 31.6/30.8, intercanthal 35.2/34.2, ear length 59.2/55.7, forehead height 72.2/68.1.
Face outline (Celebie-Jerolimov, photos), Kinh 18-25 Binh Duong, n 2462: oval 66.3%, square 26.6%, triangular 7.1%.
